digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI triggers for main branch
propositions: Cancelled workflow runs on main render as red X on GitHub despite branch health, because concurrency groups collapse queued runs and GitHub offers no native suppression mechanism
Main-branch CI must shift from push-triggered (per-commit) to scheduled (periodic state-of-health) to eliminate cancellations by construction
Scheduled health runs require published last-known-green SHA and copy-pasteable git bisect run recipe in the failure summary to enable rapid remediation

Six workflows (test, optionality, verify-identity, prompt-eval, codeql, terraform-drift) must explicitly exclude or drop push-to-main triggers while preserving non-main branch CI and pre-merge Gerrit Verified gate unchanged

Three cheap lanes (test, optionality, verify-identity) gain 6-hourly schedule cron at staggered off-the-hour minutes; two security/drift lanes (codeql, terraform-drift) keep existing cadence without increase to once-daily cap
